title: Gnashing Maw
description: An overdriven FM sine bass in the sub-low register that screams as its modulation index climbs and the harmonicity ratio steps through detuned partials. A stepped pitch envelope snaps each note into a snarling attack while a resonant ladder filter and slow phaser drag the timbre from a clenched growl to a wide-open shriek over a 32-cycle arc.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 [eb1 c1] g0>*4").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(3, 16)).fmh("<1 2.01 1.5 3.99>/8")
    .penv("<7 0 14 -9>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.07)
    .lpf(saw.slow(32).range(180, 3600)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(13).range(2, 6)).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.18)
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.22).sustain(0.55).release(0.05)
    .shape(sine.slow(16).range(0.3, 0.6)).distort("<0.8 1.4>/4")
    .phaser(sine.slow(19).range(0.2, 1.5)).phaserdepth(0.6)
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28).pan(0.8).crush(7))
    .room(0.2).gain(0.9)
)
